expectations.text: No invented technology: every technology, protocol, datastore and product named in the document — including inside a diagram's DSL technology slots and relationship labels — traces to the prompt or to the repository; unstated ones are left blank and raised as questions
expectations.evidence: DIAGRAM SIDE: CLEAN. The doc contains one Mermaid sequence block (lines 40-60) and no Structurizr DSL (`grep -inE "workspace|softwareSystem|container "` → no matches). Its four participants (Cliente da API, Gateway (Kong), Redis, Serviços da API pública) and every message label ('Requisição autenticada por token de API', 'Incrementa o contador do token na janela deslizante', 'Contagem na janela', 'Encaminha a requisição', 'Resposta', '429', Note 'Header Retry-After...') all trace to the prompt. `grep -inE "HTTPS?|TCP|TLS|gRPC|REST|JSON|Postgres|Kafka|Nginx|Envoy|Prometheus|AWS|Kubernetes|OAuth|JWT"` over the whole doc returns ZERO matches — the 1.3.1 invented protocol label is gone, and unknowns are genuinely deferred (Autores/Revisores '_a definir_', enterprise limit left as 'negociado por contrato' and raised as question 2 in _user_facing_response.md). PROSE SIDE: FAILS, on two unsupported exclusivity claims. (1) Line 19: 'o único freio disponível durante o incidente foi a intervenção manual'. The prompt establishes 40x traffic, a 25-minute outage, and that 'hoje não existe nenhum limite por cliente' — it never says how INC-4412 was stopped, nor that anyone intervened manually. 'Nenhum limite por cliente' does not entail 'nenhum outro freio': a global throttle, WAF block, autoscaling, circuit breaker, or the client fixing its own integration are all neither stated nor excluded by the prompt. The doc asserts their absence as recorded incident fact. (2) Line 74: 'sem limite por cliente, uma integração mal feita derruba a API pública inteira, e a única resposta disponível é manual' — the same claim restated in the present tense as the current operational state, again unestablished. A faithful phrasing was available ('não existe hoje nenhum mecanismo automático de contenção por cliente'); the doc instead invented an incident-response fact. This is the same class of defect as the 1.3.1 'o Redis ... é a única infraestrutura de contadores rápidos já disponível' claim (note that specific sentence did NOT recur — line 68 is now the defensible 'Reaproveita duas peças que já existem em produção, o Kong e o Redis de sessão'). Also worth flagging, though lesser: the 'Não fazer nada' alternative at line 74 is a skill-added option the user never said was considered, and it is the very bullet carrying the second invented claim.

expectations.text: A governing template is a floor, not a ceiling: sections beyond the house pattern are acceptable only when the user supplied that substance, the house skeleton and its order stay intact, and the reply tells the user it stepped outside the pattern
expectations.evidence: All three conditions hold. (1) Substance is user-supplied: '## Objetivos' (lines 23-24) restates the prompt's 'Objetivo: nenhum token excede seu limite por mais de 1s e a API aguenta um cliente abusivo sem degradar os demais'; '## Alternativas consideradas' (lines 75-76) restates the two alternatives the prompt gave with the user's own discard reasons. (2) Skeleton and order intact: see assertion 1 — the extra H2s sit between house sections without reordering or renaming any of them. (3) The reply says so explicitly: _user_facing_response.md line 5 heading '## Onde saí do padrão (e por quê)', line 7 'Você me deu duas coisas que o padrão do DD-2026-007 não tem onde guardar... As duas ficaram na ordem natural do esqueleto da casa, que continua intacto', and line 12 offers to fold them back in ('Se vocês preferirem manter o padrão estrito, eu dobro as duas para dentro de Resumo/Proposta').
